name: Toma Rin
source:
Part of unit Hot-Blood

The type of chuunibyou with an uncontrollable tingling left hand.
He has many peculiar behaviors but he's kind and polite at his core, and is harmless when left alone.
He is very sensitive to the inner workings of people's hearts.
